name: Gas (fuel) service
spec: blue square with a white fuel-pump symbol
meaning: Fuel is available at this exit.

snippets.back: Gentle acceleration and braking and fewer abrupt starts or hard stops can reduce fuel use.
To end a skid, keep the rear from outrunning the front; in a rear-wheel drive car, easing off the gas slows the rear wheels and, with steering, straightens the car.
Switch off the ignition of wrecked vehicles and avoid smoking near them because fuel may have spilled.
Cruise control on flat highways is presented as a fuel-saving practice.
In a front-wheel drive car, a light touch on the gas speeds the front wheels so the front catches up and the skid straightens.
Warn approaching traffic using suitable warning devices while taking spilled fuel and fire risk into account.
An illuminated onboard-diagnostics light can indicate poorer fuel economy or increased emissions, so ask a dealer for information.
If you hydroplane, take your foot off the accelerator; correct a partial-hydroplane skid, but in a total one just release the gas and ride it out.

result.summary: None of the snippets name or describe the Gas service sign; they only discuss fuel economy, spilled fuel, and gas-pedal use in skids/hydroplaning.
